newsitem.title: FRANCE: French health care spending slowing - Barrot.
newsitem.headline: French health care spending slowing - Barrot.

text.p: French Social Affairs Minister Jacques Barrot said on Monday figures due in the next few days will show the government closing in on its target of restricting 1996 health care spending growth to 2.1 percent for the year.

"The November figures will be published in a few days. But we know that they confirm the trend of the last months and will undoubtedly bring us a little closer to our goal of a 2.1 percent" (rise)," Barrot said at a New Year's reception.
Spending over the past few months has shown a slowdown. In October, health insurance spending was down 0.1 percent month-on-month and was 0.2 percent lower year-on-year.
